package rulefixtures

import "errors"

// scenario for mock_repository_types_duplicated_across_tests: Many copy-pasted mock repository structs with the same method sets.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type MockUserRepository struct {
	users  map[int]string
	onFind func(int) (string, error)
}

func (m *MockUserRepository) FindByID(id int) (string, error) {
	if m.onFind != nil {
		return m.onFind(id)
	}
	name, ok := m.users[id]
	if !ok {
		return "", errors.New("user not found")
	}
	return name, nil
}

func (m *MockUserRepository) Save(id int, name string) error {
	m.users[id] = name
	return nil
}
